## Privacy notice

This is a static website. It sets **no cookies**, uses **no third-party trackers**, and runs **no analytics**. No data about your visit is collected.

If you email me, I keep your message and reply; I do not use it for anything else.

Under the GDPR you may ask what data I hold about you, ask me to correct or delete it, or object to its use. Contact me at the address above.
